description: This file defines Kubernetes scheduling-related API types, including PriorityClass, Workload, PodGroup, and scheduling policies, for version v1alpha1.

classes.name: PriorityClass
classes.description: Defines a priority class with associated priority value and optional preemption policy.

classes.name: Workload
classes.description: Represents a workload with scheduling constraints, including pod groups.

classes.name: WorkloadSpec
classes.description: Specifies the desired state of a Workload, including controller reference and pod groups.

classes.name: TypedLocalObjectReference
classes.description: References a resource within the same namespace by API group, kind, and name.

classes.name: PodGroup
classes.description: Represents a set of pods with a common scheduling policy.

classes.name: PodGroupPolicy
classes.description: Defines the scheduling policy for a PodGroup, supporting basic and gang scheduling.

classes.name: GangSchedulingPolicy
classes.description: Defines parameters for gang scheduling, including minimum count of pods.
